title: Mobile Velocity Plus
description: A lightweight mobile-focused Minecraft modpack that boosts FPS, improves PvP, and enhances Survival and Multiplayer gameplay while keeping the vanilla experience intact.
body:
Mojo Boost Pack (Minecraft 1.21.11 Fabric)

Mojo Boost Pack is a lightweight, performance-focused Minecraft 1.21.11 Fabric modpack designed for smoother gameplay, improved PvP, and enhanced visual quality without changing the vanilla experience.

Whether you're playing Survival, PvP, Bedwars, Crystal PvP, or Multiplayer servers, this pack delivers higher FPS, lower lag, better combat feedback, and useful quality-of-life improvements while keeping Minecraft feeling familiar.

Features

⚡ Performance Optimized

Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, C2ME, Krypton, VMP, ImmediatelyFast, Dynamic FPS, EntityCulling, MoreCulling, BadOptimizations, and more.
Faster chunk loading, reduced memory usage, and smoother gameplay.

⚔️ PvP Enhancements

Better Hit Registration
Combat Hitboxes & Mace Hitboxes
Perfect Reach
Shield Status & Shield Fixes
Totem Counter & Totem Tweaks
Potion Counter & Status Effect Timer
Heart Indicator
Crosshair Addons & Centered Crosshair

🎨 Visual Improvements

Continuity Connected Textures
BetterGrassify
3D Skin Layers
Wavey Capes
Entity Texture Features & Entity Model Features
Fullbright Support
Custom PvP Resource Packs Included

🛠️ Quality of Life

AppleSkin
Mouse Tweaks
Shulker Box Tooltip
Chat Heads
Better Ping Display
More Chat History
Freecam
Zoomify
Armor HUD
Mod Menu Support

🎥 Content Creation Ready

Replay Mod included for cinematic recordings and montages.
Perfect For
Survival Players
Bedwars Players
Crystal PvP Players
SMP Servers
Competitive Multiplayer
Low-End and Mid-Range Devices

Experience Minecraft 1.21.11 with better performance, cleaner visuals, and competitive PvP advantages — all while staying close to the vanilla game. 🚀⛏️⚔️
